# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- For EventEase, double-booking prevention must be enforced in the booking workflow/list, not only when creating or editing events.
- For EventEase Azure deployments, use Visual Studio Publish and deploy the current working tree when explicitly selected.
- For EventEase CI/CD, use publish-profile authentication as a temporary alternative to GitHub OIDC, ensuring credentials are stored in GitHub Secrets and never hard-coded or committed.
